kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننجذب (form VII)
# نَنْجَذِبُ (nanjaḏibu) /nan.d͡ʒa.ði.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# نَنْجَذِبَ (nanjaḏiba) /nan.d͡ʒa.ði.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# نَنْجَذِبْ (nanjaḏib) /nan.d͡ʒa.ðib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
